description: Drag icons, logos, emoji and flags straight onto the canvas. Search Lucide icons, Simple Icons brand logos, full-colour tech and cloud logos, Fluent emoji and round country flags, then drag one onto the board or click to add it in view, where repeated clicks line up in rows. Pick a size, a colour and stroke for single-colour icons, keep or drop brand colours, and add a name label. Icons keep their proportions and stay sharp when zoomed.
